response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and 5 years of large-scale infrastructure/cloud compute platform design, with most roles centered on TypeScript, Node.js, and web technologies; while they have diverse experience and leadership in open-source and mentoring, their technical foundation does not align with the core requirements of the role.
strengths: Strong open-source leadership and mentoring experience with GISCollective and workshops
Proven ability to build and deploy distributed systems using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD
Broad full-stack expertise across multiple languages and domains with a focus on testability
concerns: Only minimal C++ exposure (LabWindows/CVI role), far below 8-year requirement
No evidence of cloud compute platform ownership or distributed systems at scale
Lacks documented experience in technical leadership of cloud/DevOps engineering teams
